key_highlights: ASX shed $90b in a week on rate-rise fears and oil price surge, signalling broad-based risk-off sentiment
Iron ore entering a 'bloodletting' phase, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX valuations
AUD weakened sharply on Australian growth scare, complicating import costs and commodity-linked earnings
Oil price spike (price suppression failing) lifts fuel prices by ~30c/L, pressuring Qantas.AX, Sydney Air.AX while supporting STO.AX, WDS.AX
ANZ.AX completes 3,500-job cut; restructuring plan still faces execution risk
Housing prices correcting with first-home buyer surge; no spring bounce in auction market — mixed signal for banks and REITs
Mining cap-raise activity intensifies (Canaccord-led), signalling capital stress in junior miners
Superannuation reform debate intensifies with calls for structural overhaul

sectors.trend: Iron ore in active price decline; gold underperforming; junior miners raising capital under duress; Kalgoorlie Super Pit fire adds operational risk
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression; Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources, PolarX (ASX small-caps) show relative strength but cap-raise dilution risk is elevated

sectors.trend: ANZ.AX post-restructuring (3,500 jobs cut) faces execution risk; housing correction supports NIM but weakens mortgage growth; rate-rise fears pressure equity valuations
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX, ANZ.AX benefit from higher rates but face credit-risk concerns if housing correction deepens; watch NIM vs. provision balance

sectors.trend: Oil price surge (price suppression failing) lifts upstream earnings; fuel prices +30c/L; Santos preservation seen as national sacrifice; airline costs spike
sectors.implications: STO.AX, WDS.AX, LPG.AX benefit from higher oil; QAN.AX, SYD.AX face margin pressure; fuel cost pass-through to consumers risks demand

sectors.trend: Fuel cost spike and staff shortages (1 in 3 flights cancelled) pressure airlines; business confidence deteriorating; tax burden cited as drag
sectors.implications: QAN.AX, SYD.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX face cost inflation; consumer discretionary spending at risk amid tax and fuel pressure

sectors.trend: Superannuation system under structural scrutiny; early-access rules debated; McGrath Foundation funding shift; bird flu in sea lions raises biosecurity concerns
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, HIC.AX relatively defensive; super fund managers (HUB.AX, PPA.AX) face policy uncertainty

sectors.trend: Housing price correction with first-home buyer surge; Perth CBD social rental development; NZ housing correction still running
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICOL.AX, DGL.AX) face rental yield pressure but housing correction may support affordability-driven demand; watch RBA response

key_themes: ASX $90b weekly drawdown driven by rate fears and oil spike
Iron ore price correction hitting major miners
Oil/fuel cost inflation pressuring transport and consumer sectors
Housing market correction with policy implications
Mining sector capital stress and cap-raise dilution
Geopolitical risk (Russia-Ukraine border strike, Arctic shipping)
AI spending scrutiny globally (NVIDIA, CoreWeave, Alibaba)

risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain cash buffers; favour dividend-paying defensives (STO.AX, CSL.AX); avoid leveraged small-caps

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price decline compressing miner margins
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to FMG.AX, RIO.AX; favour diversified BHP.AX; monitor Chinese steel demand data

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil/fuel cost spike inflating input costs
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge fuel exposure; favour upstream energy (WDS.AX, STO.AX) over downstream/consumer
AUD-hedged positions; favour export-oriented miners; monitor RBA commentary
Monitor bank provision ratios; favour CBA.AX, NAB.AX with stronger balance sheets over ANZ.AX
Diversify; hold gold-equity exposure (GOLD.AX, NVL.AX) as hedge

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight upstream energy on oil price surge
opportunities.rationale: Oil price suppression failing; fuel prices +30c; Santos preservation signals structural support for Australian gas

opportunities.recommendation: Selective mining exposure via diversified majors
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting hurts pure-plays; BHP's copper/gold diversification offers relative resilience; small-cap miners (PolarX, Sunstone) show momentum but cap-raise risk
Superannuation debate and tax pressure support defensive positioning; CSL.AX, WES.AX, WOW.AX offer income and stability

defensive_moves.rationale: Active price decline; FMG and RIO most exposed; cap-raise dilution in juniors

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness and rate risk
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; rate-rise fears driving $90b ASX drawdown; maintain 10-15% cash or short-duration bonds

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid airline and fuel-intensive transport names
defensive_moves.rationale: Fuel +30c/L, staff shortages causing 1-in-3 cancellations; margin compression likely through Q1 2027

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure over 1-3 months as rate-rise fears persist, oil volatility continues, and iron ore correction plays out. AUD weakness adds import-cost inflation. Expect choppy, risk-off conditions with sector rotation toward energy and defensives.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook stabilises if RBA pivots on growth scare and iron ore finds a floor. Housing correction may support bank NIMs. Superannuation reform could unlock capital flows. AI capex scrutiny globally may moderate tech valuations but Australian tech exposure is limited.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement
Iron ore price trajectory (Chinese stimulus signals)
Oil price direction and OPEC+ policy
US Fed meeting and Warsh rate expectations
watch_list: Brent crude and Australian domestic fuel prices
RBA cash rate and forward guidance
ANZ.AX, CBA.AX NIM and provision trends
Housing auction clearance rates and price indices
